questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true of the assessment of power in the arms?

options.A: Extension at the elbow is produced by the biceps muscle
options.B: Grade 3/5 (MRC scale) represents movement of the arm only when gravity is eliminated
options.C: Grade 2/5 power represents movement of the arm only against gravity.
options.D: The brachioradialis muscle is responsible for shoulder abduction
options.E: Grade 0/5 power represents full range of motion with resistance

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Extension at the elbow is produced by the biceps muscle
